<body>
<h1>🐣 INKUBATOR ESP32-S3</h1>

<div id="alertBox" class="alert-box"></div>
<div id="statusBar">

<div class="grid">

  <!-- TEMPERATURY -->
  <div class="card">

    <div class="row">

      <span class="lbl">Akwarium (DS#1)</span>

    </div>
    <div class="row">
      <span class="lbl">BMP180 (ciśnienie)</span>
      <span class="val" id="pressure">--</span><span style="color:#aaa;font-size:0.8em"> hPa</span>
    </div>
    <div class="row">
      <span class="lbl">BMP180 (temp)</span>
      <span class="val" id="bmpTemp">--</span><span style="color:#aaa;font-size:0.8em"> °C</span>
    </div>
    <div class="row">
      <span class="lbl">Target</span>

    </div>

  <!-- WILGOTNOŚĆ -->
  <div class="card">
    <h2>💧 Wilgotność (DHT11)</h2>
    <div class="row">
      <span class="lbl">Wilgotność</span>
      <span class="val" id="humidity">--</span><span style="color:#aaa;font-size:0.8em"> %</span>
    </div>
    <div class="row">
      <span class="lbl">Zakres docelowy</span>
      <span class="val ok" id="humRange">--</span><span style="color:#aaa;font-size:0.8em"> %</span>
    </div>
    <div class="row">
      <span class="lbl">Dyfuzor</span>
      <span class="badge off" id="diffuserBadge">OFF</span>
    </div>
    <div class="row">
      <span class="lbl">Poziom wody</span>
      <span class="val" id="waterLevel">--</span>
    </div>
    <div class="controls">
      <button class="btn-success" onclick="apiPost('/api/config','diffuser_force_on')">💦 Dyfuzor ON</button>
      <button class="btn-secondary" onclick="apiPost('/api/config','diffuser_force_off')">⏸ Dyfuzor OFF</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- GRZAŁKI -->
  <div class="card">
    <h2>🔥 Grzałki PWM (GPIO1+GPIO2)</h2>
    <div class="row">
      <span class="lbl">PWM Aktualny</span>
      <div class="bar-wrap"><div class="bar" id="heaterBar" style="width:0%">0%</div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="row" style="flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 6px;">
      <span class="lbl">Target temperatura</span>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-top:4px;">
        <input type="number" id="targetInput" value="37.5" min="20" max="45" step="0.1">
        <button class="btn-primary" onclick="setTargetTemp()">✓ Ustaw</button>
      </div>

    <div class="row">
      <span class="lbl">Drzwi</span>

      <span class="badge off" id="testBadge">NIE</span>

  </div>

  <!-- TACE -->
  <div class="card">
    <h2>🔄 Tace (2PH63091A Relay)</h2>
    <div id="traysContainer">Ładowanie...</div>
    <div style="color:#555;font-size:0.75em;margin-top:10px;">LOW=pracuje, HIGH=STOP (lockdown)</div>
  </div>

  <!-- INKUBACJA - DZIEŃ -->
  <div class="card">
    <h2>📅 Postęp Inkubacji</h2>
    <div id="incubationContainer">Ładowanie...</div>
  </div>

  <!-- STEROWANIE SYSTEMEM -->
  <div class="card">
    <h2>⚙️ System</h2>
    <div class="row">
      <span class="lbl">Uptime</span>
      <span class="val ok" id="uptime">00:00</span>
    </div>
    <div class="row">
      <span class="lbl">WiFi AP</span>
      <span class="badge on">INKUBATOR</span>
    </div>
    <div class="row">
      <span class="lbl">Config v</span>
      <span class="val" id="configVer">--</span>
    </div>

      <button class="btn-warning" onclick="if(confirm('Reset czasu inkubacji?')) apiPost('/api/reset','')">🔄 Reset czasu</button>
      <button class="btn-success" onclick="apiPost('/api/config','test_toggle')">🧪 Test mode</button>
      <button class="btn-danger" onclick="if(confirm('Reboot ESP32?')) apiPost('/api/reboot','')">⚡ Reboot</button>
    </div>
    <div class="controls">
      <button class="btn-secondary" onclick="if(confirm('FACTORY RESET? Usunie config!')) sendFactoryReset()">🏭 Factory Reset</button>
      <a href="/api/log" style="text-decoration:none"><button class="btn-secondary">📥 Pobierz Log CSV</button></a>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>

<div class="footer">
  ESP32-S3 Inkubator v2.0 | IP: 192.168.4.1 | SSID: INKUBATOR | Auto-refresh: 3s
</div>

<script>
let lastStatus = null;
let lastTrays = null;

async function fetchAll() {
  try {
    const [sResp, tResp] = await Promise.all([
      fetch('/api/status'),
      fetch('/api/trays')
    ]);
    if (sResp.ok) lastStatus = await sResp.json();
    if (tResp.ok) lastTrays = await tResp.json();
    updateUI();
    updateStatusBar(true);
  } catch (e) {
    updateStatusBar(false);
  }
}

function updateStatusBar(ok) {
  const bar = document.getElementById('statusBar');
  const upd = document.getElementById('lastUpdate');
  upd.textContent = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('pl-PL');
  if (ok) {
    bar.className = '';
    bar.firstElementChild.textContent = lastStatus?.alert ? '⚠️ ' + lastStatus.alert : '✅ System OK';
    bar.className = lastStatus?.alert ? 'warn' : '';
  } else {
    bar.className = 'warn';
    bar.firstElementChild.textContent = '❌ Brak połączenia z ESP32';
  }
  const alertBox = document.getElementById('alertBox');
  if (lastStatus?.alert) {
    alertBox.textContent = '⚠️ ' + lastStatus.alert;
    alertBox.style.display = 'block';
  } else {
    alertBox.style.display = 'none';
  }
}

function updateUI() {
  if (!lastStatus) return;
  const d = lastStatus;

  // Temperatury
  const t0 = d.temp_chamber;
  const el0 = document.getElementById('temp0');
  el0.textContent = t0 < -50 ? 'BRAK' : t0.toFixed(1);
  el0.className = 'val ' + (t0 < -50 ? 'err' : Math.abs(t0 - d.target_temp) < 1 ? 'ok' : 'warn');

  const t1 = d.temp_aquarium;
  const el1 = document.getElementById('temp1');
  el1.textContent = t1 < -50 ? 'BRAK' : t1.toFixed(1);
  el1.className = 'val ' + (t1 < -50 ? 'err' : d.aquarium_ok ? 'ok' : 'warn');

  const pr = d.pressure_hpa;
  document.getElementById('pressure').textContent = pr > 0 ? pr.toFixed(0) : 'BRAK';
  const bt = d.bmp180_temp;
  document.getElementById('bmpTemp').textContent = bt > -50 ? bt.toFixed(1) : 'BRAK';
  document.getElementById('targetTemp').textContent = d.target_temp.toFixed(1);
  document.getElementById('targetInput').value = d.target_temp.toFixed(1);

  // Wilgotność
  const hum = d.humidity;
  const humEl = document.getElementById('humidity');
  humEl.textContent = hum < 0 ? 'BRAK' : hum.toFixed(1);
  humEl.className = 'val ' + (hum < 0 ? 'err' : 'ok');
  document.getElementById('humRange').textContent = `${d.humidity_target_min} – ${d.humidity_target_max}`;

  const diff = document.getElementById('diffuserBadge');
  diff.textContent = d.diffuser_on ? 'ON' : 'OFF';
  diff.className = 'badge ' + (d.diffuser_on ? 'on' : 'off');

  const wl = d.water_level;
  const wlEl = document.getElementById('waterLevel');
  if (wl < 0) { wlEl.textContent = 'WYŁĄCZONY'; wlEl.className = 'val'; }
  else { wlEl.textContent = wl > 2048 ? '💧 NAPEŁNIONY' : '⚠️ NISKI'; wlEl.className = 'val ' + (wl > 2048 ? 'ok' : 'warn'); }

  // Grzałki
  const pwm = d.heater_pwm || 0;
  const bar = document.getElementById('heaterBar');
  bar.style.width = pwm + '%';
  bar.textContent = pwm.toFixed(0) + '%';

  const door = document.getElementById('doorBadge');
  door.textContent = d.door_open ? 'OTWARTE!' : 'ZAMKNIĘTE';
  door.className = 'badge ' + (d.door_open ? 'off' : 'on');

  const testBadge = document.getElementById('testBadge');
  testBadge.textContent = d.test_mode ? 'TAK' : 'NIE';
  testBadge.className = 'badge ' + (d.test_mode ? 'on' : 'off');

  document.getElementById('configVer').textContent = d.config_version || '--';

  const ms = d.uptime_ms || 0;
  const h = Math.floor(ms / 3600000);
  const m = Math.floor((ms % 3600000) / 60000);
  document.getElementById('uptime').textContent = `${h}h ${m}m`;

  // Tace
  if (lastTrays && lastTrays.trays) {
    let html = '';
    for (const t of lastTrays.trays) {
      const working = t.active && t.pin_active;
      const stopped = t.active && t.in_lockdown;
      const inactive = !t.active;
      let state = working ? '<span class="badge on">PRACUJE</span>' :
                  stopped ? '<span class="badge warn" style="color:#ffc107;border-color:#ffc107">LOCKDOWN</span>' :
                  '<span class="badge off">STOP</span>';
      html += `<div class="row">
        <div style="flex:1">
          <div class="lbl">${t.label} (GPIO${t.pin})</div>
          <div style="font-size:0.75em;color:#555;">Dzień ${t.current_day}/${t.total_days} | ${t.species_name}</div>
        </div>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;">
          ${state}
          <button class="btn-secondary" style="padding:4px 8px;font-size:0.75em" onclick="toggleTray(${t.index},${!t.active})">${t.active ? '⏹' : '▶️'}</button>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    }
    document.getElementById('traysContainer').innerHTML = html;
  }

  // Inkubacja
  const tr = lastTrays?.trays;
  if (tr) {
    let html = '';
    for (const t of tr) {
      if (!t.active) continue;
      const pct = t.total_days > 0 ? Math.round(t.current_day / t.total_days * 100) : 0;
      html += `<div style="margin-bottom:12px">
        <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:4px">
          <span class="lbl">${t.label}</span>
          <span style="color:#4ecca3;font-size:0.85em">Dzień ${t.current_day} / ${t.total_days}</span>
        </div>
        <div style="background:#0f3460;border-radius:4px;height:14px;overflow:hidden">
          <div style="width:${pct}%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4ecca3,#e94560)"></div>
        </div>
        <div style="font-size:0.75em;color:#aaa;margin-top:3px">
          ${t.in_lockdown ? '🔒 LOCKDOWN!' : t.should_rotate ? '🔄 Obrót' : '⏸ Brak obrotu'}
          | ${t.days_remaining} dni do wylęgu
          ${t.notes ? '| ' + t.notes : ''}
        </div>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:6px">
          <span style="font-size:0.75em;color:#aaa">Ustaw dzień:</span>
          <input type="number" id="dayInput_${t.index}" value="${t.current_day}" min="1" max="${t.total_days}" style="width:60px">
          <button class="btn-secondary" style="padding:3px 8px;font-size:0.75em" onclick="setTrayDay(${t.index})">✓</button>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    }
    if (!html) html = '<div style="color:#555">Brak aktywnych tac</div>';
    document.getElementById('incubationContainer').innerHTML = html;
  }
}

async function apiPost(url, action) {
  try {
    let body = action;
    const resp = await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, body });
    const r = await resp.json();
    if (r.ok || r.message) {
      setTimeout(fetchAll, 500);
    } else {
      alert('Błąd: ' + (r.error || JSON.stringify(r)));
    }
  } catch (e) { alert('Błąd połączenia: ' + e.message); }
}

async function toggleTray(idx, active) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ tray: idx, active: active });
  await fetch('/api/tray/set-active?' + params, { method: 'POST' });
  setTimeout(fetchAll, 300);
}

async function setTrayDay(idx) {
  const day = document.getElementById('dayInput_' + idx).value;
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ tray: idx, day: day });
  const r = await fetch('/api/tray/set-day?' + params, { method: 'POST' });
  const j = await r.json();
  if (!j.ok) alert('Błąd: ' + (j.error || 'nieznany'));
  setTimeout(fetchAll, 300);
}

async function setTargetTemp() {
  const temp = parseFloat(document.getElementById('targetInput').value);
  if (isNaN(temp) || temp < 20 || temp > 45) { alert('Temperatura 20-45°C'); return; }
  const cfg = { system: { target_temp: temp } };
  await fetch('/api/config', { method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify(cfg) });
  setTimeout(fetchAll, 300);
}

async function sendFactoryReset() {
  await fetch('/api/config', { method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({factory_reset:true}) });
  setTimeout(fetchAll, 1000);
}

fetchAll();
setInterval(fetchAll, 3000);
</script>
</body>
</html>

<html lang="pl">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">

      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;

    .grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
    .card {
      background: white;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 20px;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
    }
    .card h2 { color: #667eea; margin-bottom: 15px; font-size: 1.3em; border-bottom: 2px solid #667eea; padding-bottom: 10px; }
    .item { margin: 15px 0; padding: 12px; background: #f5f5f5; border-left: 4px solid #667eea; border-radius: 5px; }
    .label { font-weight: bold; color: #333; font-size: 0.9em; }
    .value { font-size: 2em; color: #667eea; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 8px; }
    .unit { font-size: 0.7em; color: #999; margin-left: 5px; }
    .status-on { background: #d4edda; border-left-color: #28a745; }
    .status-off { background: #f8d7da; border-left-color: #dc3545; }
    .pwm-bar { width: 100%; height: 30px; background: #e0e0e0; border-radius: 5px; overflow: hidden; position: relative; margin-top: 8px; }
    .pwm-fill { height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ffc107, #ff9800); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: white; font-weight: bold; font-size: 0.85em; }
    .last-update { text-align: center; color: #999; font-size: 0.85em; margin-top: 20px; padding: 15px; background: white; border-radius: 10px; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="container">
  <h1>🐔 INKUBATOR - PANEL TESTOWY</h1>
  
  <div class="grid">
    <!-- TEMPERATURY DS18B20 -->
    <div class="card">
      <h2>🌡️ Czujniki DS18B20</h2>
      <div class="item">
        <div class="label">DS18B20 #1 (Jaja)</div>
        <div class="value"><span id="temp0">--</span><span class="unit">°C</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="item">
        <div class="label">DS18B20 #2 (Akwarium)</div>
        <div class="value"><span id="temp1">--</span><span class="unit">°C</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="item">
        <div class="label">Cel (Target)</div>
        <div class="value"><span id="target">--</span><span class="unit">°C</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- DHT11 -->
    <div class="card">
      <h2>💧 DHT11 (Wilgotność)</h2>
      <div class="item">
        <div class="label">Wilgotność</div>
        <div class="value"><span id="humidity">--</span><span class="unit">%</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="item">
        <div class="label">Zakres Docelowy</div>
        <div class="value"><span id="humRange">--</span><span class="unit">%</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- TACE -->
    <div class="card">
      <h2>🔄 Tace (Relais)</h2>
      <div class="item status-off" id="tray0">
        <div class="label">Taca 1 (GPIO18)</div>
        <div style="margin-top: 8px; font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.3em;">❌ WYŁĄCZONA</div>
      </div>
      <div class="item status-off" id="tray1">
        <div class="label">Taca 2 (GPIO19)</div>
        <div style="margin-top: 8px; font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.3em;">❌ WYŁĄCZONA</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- GRZAŁKI PWM -->
    <div class="card">
      <h2>🔥 Grzałki (PWM)</h2>
      <div class="item">
        <div class="label">Grzałka 1 (CH0 - GPIO12)</div>
        <div class="pwm-bar">
          <div class="pwm-fill" id="pwm1" style="width: 0%;">
            <span id="pwm1Pct">0%</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="item">
        <div class="label">Grzałka 2 (CH1 - GPIO13)</div>
        <div class="pwm-bar">
          <div class="pwm-fill" id="pwm2" style="width: 0%;">
            <span id="pwm2Pct">0%</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- STATUS SYSTEMU -->
    <div class="card">
      <h2>⚙️ Status Systemu</h2>
      <div class="item">
        <div class="label">Czas pracy</div>
        <div class="value" id="uptime">00:00:00</div>
      </div>
      <div class="item">
        <div class="label">Tryb testowy</div>
        <div class="value" id="testMode">--</div>
      </div>
      <div class="item">
        <div class="label">Wersja konfiguracji</div>
        <div class="value" id="configVer">--</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="last-update">
    Ostatnia aktualizacja: <span id="lastUpdate">--:--:--</span> | Odśwież stronę aby zobaczyć nowe dane
  </div>
</div>

<script>
  async function fetchData() {
    try {
      const resp = await fetch('/api/status');
      const data = await resp.json();
      updateUI(data);
    } catch (err) {
      console.log('Błąd API:', err);
    }
  }

  function updateUI(data) {
    // DS18B20
    document.getElementById('temp0').textContent = (data.temp_chamber || 0).toFixed(1);
    document.getElementById('temp1').textContent = (data.temp_aquarium || 0).toFixed(1);
    document.getElementById('target').textContent = (data.target_temp || 0).toFixed(1);

    // DHT11
    const hum = data.humidity >= 0 ? data.humidity.toFixed(1) : '--';
    document.getElementById('humidity').textContent = hum;
    document.getElementById('humRange').textContent = `${data.humidity_target_min || 0} - ${data.humidity_target_max || 0}`;

    // Tace
    const tray0 = document.getElementById('tray0');
    const tray1 = document.getElementById('tray1');
    
    if (data.trays && data.trays.length > 0) {
      tray0.className = data.trays[0]?.active ? 'item status-on' : 'item status-off';
      tray0.innerHTML = '<div class="label">Taca 1 (GPIO18)</div><div style="margin-top: 8px; font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.3em;">' + 
                        (data.trays[0]?.active ? '✅ WŁĄCZONA' : '❌ WYŁĄCZONA') + '</div>';
      
      tray1.className = data.trays[1]?.active ? 'item status-on' : 'item status-off';
      tray1.innerHTML = '<div class="label">Taca 2 (GPIO19)</div><div style="margin-top: 8px; font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.3em;">' + 
                        (data.trays[1]?.active ? '✅ WŁĄCZONA' : '❌ WYŁĄCZONA') + '</div>';
    }

    // PWM Grzałki (oba kanały mają tę samą moc)
    const pwm = data.heater_pwm || 0;
    document.getElementById('pwm1').style.width = pwm + '%';
    document.getElementById('pwm1Pct').textContent = pwm.toFixed(0) + '%';
    document.getElementById('pwm2').style.width = pwm + '%';
    document.getElementById('pwm2Pct').textContent = pwm.toFixed(0) + '%';

    // Status systemu
    const ms = data.uptime_ms || 0;
    const sec = Math.floor((ms / 1000) % 60);
    const min = Math.floor((ms / 60000) % 60);
    const hrs = Math.floor(ms / 3600000);
    document.getElementById('uptime').textContent = 
      String(hrs).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(min).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(sec).padStart(2, '0');
    
    document.getElementById('testMode').textContent = data.test_mode ? 'TAK' : 'NIE';
    document.getElementById('configVer').textContent = data.config_version || '--';

    // Czas
    const now = new Date();
    document.getElementById('lastUpdate').textContent = now.toLocaleTimeString('pl-PL');
  }

  // Inicjalizacja
  fetchData();
  setInterval(fetchData, 3000);
</script>
</body>
</html>
